newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: EMCO says final Oct prices will need recalculating.
newsitem.headline: EMCO says final Oct prices will need recalculating.

text.p: Electricity market operator EMCO said on Tuesday that final wholesale prices for October would need to be recalculated because final metering data were incomplete.
EMCO said it would release final prices to the market on Tuesday at 4 p.m. but these would require revision.
"The use of a full set of metering data is likely to mean that prices will ultimately be lower than those published today," EMCO said in a statement.

The Market Surveillance Committee said in an attached statement that the final metering data supplied by grid operator Transpower were incomplete, as they did not include non-New Zealand Electricity Market (NZEM) generation.
"While these generators are small, combined they have a maximum capacity of 100 megawatts," the Committee said.
In the absence of generation data from non-market participants, it said prices could be assumed to be wrong for every half hour where one of these stations ran.
"This error will have a tendency to cause prices to be higher than they ought to be. In the committee's view, this must be corrected," it said.

Clearing manager EMCO was likely to incur considerable extra cost in recalculating the prices, the committee added. It noted market rules provide that wash ups (including interest being paid by those who had been overpaid and being paid to those who overpaid) may occur when invoicing data changes.
The committee said an "undesirable situation" had arisen, as incorrect prices would threaten fair, orderly and proper trading.
It ordered EMCO to publish temporary final prices on Tuesday, recalculate them when all data was available, and then conduct a wash up.
It ordered Transpower to prepare a full report on why the necessary data was not supplied to EMCO and what had been done to ensure no repetition.
EMCO's surveillance and compliance team had also been authorised to carry out an investigation.
EMCO said recalculated final prices would be released around the middle of next week.
